Watching @LZGranderson on @CNN right now. 

With tears in my eyes and a lump in my throat. 

Thank you for being strong enough to share. 

#BlackLivesMatter

I just drove down Flatbush Avenue in #Brooklyn right before curfew. 

A peaceful protest was gathering.  Hundreds maybe thousands of people.  

The protest was majority white. 

They were holding #BlackLivesMatter signs, wearing masks and ready to march. 

Change is coming.

Thankful to Dr Jenny Castillo and others who organized.  

Grateful for our city and her people. 

We kneel for #BreonnaTaylor #GeorgeFloyd and so many who’s names we don’t know.  

#WhiteCoatsForBlackLives #BlackLivesMatter

Taking no shit from this fool on mask wearing or #BlackLivesMatter.   

Love my Brooklyn.
